_law: Both candidates export into THIS schema. Neither may receive a privileged field, and no field here names or favours a candidate architecture. Ownership of the underlying rows is the AQ4 decision itself and is NOT decided by this file (contract 23, models A-D stay open).
_what: AQ4 ownership-neutral EVALUATION PROJECTION schema. Packet 4. This is benchmark evaluation law only: it creates no production law, ratifies no architecture, mints no production vocabulary, and authorizes no candidate encoder. Production AQ4 architecture remains UNRATIFIED.

action_heads._law: An action/predicate head is NOT a dimension (contract 14, register 23). It says what the occurrence DOES; dimensions say what an object must BE. Keeping them apart is what stops a detector improvement arriving as a silent dimension ratification.
action_heads.multiple_heads: REQUIRED to be representable; printed order is semantic and is NEVER sorted
action_heads.vocabulary_source: CR 701 keyword actions parsed at run time, plus the object-lattice printed action words; never a hand-list
forbidden: encoding an action head as a dimension row
fabricating a head where the detector reaches none

artifact_roles._law: Declared ONCE at document level. Artifact identity already establishes whose rows these are, so no per-row party field exists or may be added (P4-R2). Storing it per row would create a second source of truth.

atom_operators.meaning: v not in values(object, dim) -- NOT_HAS, never HAS-complement
verbatim equality on an equality-only dimension

canonical_serialization.newline: LF, exactly one at end of file

surface_id_digest._why: Chosen as the Packet-4 canonical form because it reproduces two already-accepted historical digests exactly. The delimiter is safe: an oracle_id is a hyphenated UUID and the other three coordinates are integers, so no coordinate can contain the delimiter.
surface_id_digest.sort: lexicographic over the id string, unique
surface_id_digest.unit: each id encoded UTF-8 and followed by exactly one LF, fed in sorted order

dimensions.name: zone
dimensions.note: 'Outside the game' is NOT a zone (CR 400.11) and is never a value

dimensions.name: entity_kind
dimensions.note: core {permanent, card, spell}; absence from the core is NOT proof

dimensions.name: sort
dimensions.note: 'player' is a contracted value; mixed slots are unions, never a coordinate on the participant

dimensions.name: controller_relation
dimensions.note: complement inference FORBIDDEN; the benchmark assumes no player count

dimensions.name: selection_mode
dimensions.note: unhandled shapes are UNRESOLVED, never coerced

dimensions_provenance: Contract section 14 minimum-useful v1 sheet, Captain 2026-08-16, register 16. This file is the machine-readable copy the validator reads; section 14 remains the ratifying text and the validator asserts containment (schema is a SUBSET of section 14) rather than re-parsing the markdown table as its vocabulary source.

dispositions._law: Exactly five. No sixth disposition is created by Packet 4 (P4-R2).

evidence._law: Normalization may ASSIST deterministic detection, but it never becomes evidence. Every surviving projected semantic fact carries a deterministic trace to admissible source evidence in the RAW view (contract 19, register 21).
evidence.reminder_text_rule: CR 207.2a reminder text remains present in the raw evidence view and stays trace-visible, but it mints no semantic occurrence and is NOT independently claim-admissible. A fact whose only support is a span lying wholly inside a reminder parenthetical HALTS.

forbidden_fields._law: Each entry is refused by the validator wherever it appears in a projection object, at any depth. Written as data, never as prose vocabulary.

forbidden_native_vocabulary._law: Candidate-native ownership/storage concepts and candidate names may not appear as schema branches or field names. Rejected terms are listed as DATA here so no document has to spell them in a position a vocabulary harvester would ingest.

occurrence_address._law: Four coordinates, no fifth. The clause ordinal is owned by the ratified segmentation, never minted by a matching extractor. The [face, paragraph] prefix equals the ratified locality of the assertion a fact refines.

ordering._law: Canonicalization may reorder and normalize representation. It may NEVER invent or drop a semantic fact, and it may never reorder something whose order is semantic.
ordering.facts: sorted by (scope, participant, dimension, canonical atom)

participants._law: A bare integer ordinal local to the occurrence. There is NO participant kind/type coordinate: a single printed slot may range over players AND objects at once (CR 115.4 / CR 115.1), measured on 1,528 cards. The filler's sort is a constraint atom over the 'sort' dimension, never a coordinate on the participant.
participants.representation: sorted list of non-negative integers; facts reference an ordinal

status: PRE-REGISTERED benchmark evaluation law. Production AQ4 architecture remains UNRATIFIED; this schema decides no production canonical ownership and authorizes no candidate encoder.

relation_kinds._law: Same-card references only. Edges name occurrences/participants, never game objects. An unresolvable reference stays UNRESOLVED and is never guessed. Runtime object binding is permanently out of scope.

structural_regions._law: P4-R1. COST is STRUCTURAL ability content, not an eligibility dimension. The marker is POSITIONAL and CR-grounded -- effect text that merely discusses paying or sacrificing is NOT a COST region. Material not proven to occupy a structural cost position stays unmarked.
cr_grounded_boundaries: CR 113.3b / CR 602.1a -- activation cost is everything before the colon
CR 606.2 -- a loyalty symbol in the cost makes it a loyalty ability
CR 702.6b / 702.Na -- a keyword's em-dash body is the keyword's own COST, not an effect
forbidden: a positive EFFECT role as the complement of COST
a cost dimension in the dimension list
internal decomposition of a composite cost
structural_regions.v1_composite_rule: A composite activated cost (mana + tap + sacrifice) remains ONE COST region in v1.
structural_regions.v1_out_of_scope_reported: The bare keyword-parameter form ('Equip {3}') is NOT derived in v1; deriving it needs keyword-parameter parsing of the kind this packet is forbidden to build. Recorded rather than silently omitted.
